name: HUMMAN_A_ONLY_MATCHED_TRANSLATION_RIGID_V1
initialization: Historical Official native vertices, actual SHA checked against original results
observations: Original fixed Camera A maximum 5000 points, unchanged source indices
surface: Original 16384 barycentric anchors, fixed shape and scale
correspondence: observed A points to nearest transformed anchor
matched_translation: mean residual, per-axis step clipped to +/-0.05m
matched_rigid: proper fixed-scale Kabsch on same retained pairs; full rotation step; translation step clipped to +/-0.05m
rigid_pivot: fixed centroid of original Official mesh in Camera A
fallback: if norm(d)>bound, apply original mesh (identity rotation and zero translation)
reference_baseline: Historical median-update Cheap Txyz remains separate; mean-update is a matched control, not relabeled Cheap Txyz
evaluation: Only after transforms fixed/saved, original Camera B 2048 points to historical exact triangles
interpretation: Algorithm-specific rotation diagnostic, not optimal SE3 oracle or proof rotation is universally unnecessary
selection: all TRAIN/VAL frames retained; no B tuning; no sealed TEST
